He holds a pink ordering menu and a blue pen, smiling enthusiastically at someone off-camera. The background environment features blurred industrial elements and typical casual restaurant furniture like red stools. (2) The scene shifts to a medium shot featuring two men at a table; the primary character in the sweater and a friend in a dark grey button-down shirt. They engage in a lively discussion while the first man points at the menu. Close-up shots highlight the detailed list of food items on the pink paper with various checkboxes. (3) A third male character in a white sweatshirt enters the frame, providing explanations with high-arousal facial expressions. The camera focuses on specific food items including a large plate of leafy green vegetables (Tonghao) and a silver ladle lifting a piece of dark duck blood from a brownish broth.
